notes: «بإسناد مالك» is a back_reference to Malik's chain (the Muwatta); no previous report is in the context.

The compiler's remark («قال أبو داود كذلك رواه ابن وهب عن مالك وحفص بن ميسرة وداود بن قيس وهشام بن سعد») names other transmitters for the same saying: each is a variant group, never a route; the compiler's own name is not written.
«ثم ذكر معنى مالك» is a note on Malik's meaning, left out.
